mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2.5% does not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE spikes do not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or HOUST declines do not correlate with subsequent economic slowdowns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increases do not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of high FEDFUNDS and rising CPI does not correlate with subsequent market downturns.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS does not correlate with subsequent market downturns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real final sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS declines do not correlate with subsequent economic slowdowns.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4%) indicates a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS > 4%, or high FEDFUNDS does not correlate with subsequent market downturns.
